start.title: File:Blue Mosque Courtyard Dusk Wikimedia Commons.jpg
start.alt: The courtyard of the Sultan Ahmed Mosque in Istanbul at dusk, its domes and minarets lit against a deep blue sky
start.caption: Evening falls over a mosque courtyard: the guide begins where the night begins.
start.alt_ms: Halaman Masjid Sultan Ahmed di Istanbul ketika senja, dengan kubah dan menaranya bercahaya berlatarkan langit biru tua
start.caption_ms: Senja di halaman masjid: panduan ini bermula ketika malam bermula.

what.title: File:Crescent moon - Hilal.jpg
what.alt: A thin crescent moon in a darkening sky
what.caption: The new crescent (hilāl) that opens each lunar month.
what.alt_ms: Anak bulan sabit yang nipis di langit yang semakin gelap
what.caption_ms: Anak bulan (hilal) yang membuka setiap bulan qamariah.

what.title: File:Desert Stars (iotw2024a).jpg
what.alt: A clear night sky full of stars above a desert landscape
what.caption: A clear desert night. The Qurʾān calls the night of decree “peace, until the rising of the dawn.”
what.alt_ms: Langit malam yang cerah dan penuh bintang di atas padang pasir
what.caption_ms: Malam padang pasir yang cerah. Al-Quran menyifatkan malam penentuan itu sebagai “sejahtera hingga terbit fajar.”

surah.title: File:Folios from a Qur'an Manuscript MET sf26-161-1r.jpg
surah.alt: Two folios of an early Qurʾān manuscript in brown ink on parchment, with gold verse markers
surah.caption: Folios from an early Qurʾān manuscript, Metropolitan Museum of Art.
surah.alt_ms: Dua helaian manuskrip al-Quran awal bertinta coklat di atas kulit, dengan penanda ayat berwarna emas
surah.caption_ms: Helaian manuskrip al-Quran awal, Metropolitan Museum of Art.

surah.title: File:Tapurian Qur'an (Al-Qadr).PNG
surah.alt: A page of a historic Qurʾān manuscript with Sūrat al-Qadr in Arabic and an interlinear Persian translation
surah.caption: Sūrat al-Qadr in the Tapurian Qurʾān, a historic manuscript with an interlinear Persian translation.
surah.alt_ms: Halaman manuskrip al-Quran bersejarah yang memuatkan Surah al-Qadr dalam bahasa Arab dengan terjemahan Parsi di antara barisnya
surah.caption_ms: Surah al-Qadr dalam al-Quran Tapuria, manuskrip bersejarah dengan terjemahan Parsi di antara barisnya.

when.title: File:Waxing Crescent Moon 13 February 2026.jpg
when.alt: A waxing crescent moon against a black sky
when.caption: A waxing crescent. The Islamic month begins at sunset, so each night precedes its day.
when.alt_ms: Bulan sabit yang semakin membesar berlatarkan langit hitam
when.caption_ms: Bulan sabit yang semakin membesar. Bulan Islam bermula ketika matahari terbenam, maka setiap malam mendahului siangnya.

when.title: File:Stars@desertSunset(byTdeGroot).JPG
when.alt: The first stars appearing over a desert just after sunset
when.caption: The first stars after sunset, when an odd night of the last ten begins.
when.alt_ms: Bintang-bintang pertama muncul di atas padang pasir sejurus selepas matahari terbenam
when.caption_ms: Bintang-bintang pertama selepas matahari terbenam, ketika bermulanya malam ganjil sepuluh malam terakhir.

last10.title: File:Jemaah bersujud tampak belakang.jpg
last10.alt: Rows of worshippers in prostration in a mosque, seen from behind
last10.caption: Congregational prayer in a mosque during Ramadan.
last10.alt_ms: Saf-saf jemaah sedang sujud di dalam masjid, dilihat dari belakang
last10.caption_ms: Solat berjemaah di masjid pada bulan Ramadan.

last10.title: File:Iktikaf.jpg
last10.alt: Worshippers resting and reading in a mosque during iʿtikāf, the retreat of the last ten nights
last10.caption: Iʿtikāf: staying in the mosque for worship in the last ten nights.
last10.alt_ms: Jemaah berehat dan membaca di dalam masjid ketika iktikaf, ibadah berdiam di masjid pada sepuluh malam terakhir
last10.caption_ms: Iktikaf: berdiam di masjid untuk beribadah pada sepuluh malam terakhir.

signs.title: File:A Desert Dawn (226203045).jpeg
signs.alt: The sun rising softly over a desert horizon
signs.caption: Dawn over the desert. A reported sign of the night is a morning sun without strong rays.
signs.alt_ms: Matahari terbit dengan lembut di ufuk padang pasir
signs.caption_ms: Fajar di padang pasir. Antara tanda malam itu yang diriwayatkan ialah matahari pagi yang tidak memancarkan sinar yang terik.

signs.title: File:Wadi Shawka night sky 01.jpg
signs.alt: A calm, clear night sky over the mountains of Wadi Shawka in the United Arab Emirates
signs.caption: A still, clear night in the Arabian Peninsula.
signs.alt_ms: Langit malam yang tenang dan cerah di atas pergunungan Wadi Shawka di Emiriah Arab Bersatu
signs.caption_ms: Malam yang hening dan cerah di Semenanjung Arab.

worship.title: File:Tarawih Prayers at Istiqlal.jpg
worship.alt: Long rows of worshippers standing in the night prayer of Ramadan in the Istiqlal Mosque, Jakarta
worship.caption: The night prayer of Ramadan in the Istiqlal Mosque, Jakarta.
worship.alt_ms: Saf-saf panjang jemaah berdiri dalam solat malam Ramadan di Masjid Istiqlal, Jakarta
worship.caption_ms: Solat malam Ramadan di Masjid Istiqlal, Jakarta.

worship.title: File:Iktikaf while reading the Quran at the Ubay bin Kaab Mosque.jpg
worship.alt: A worshipper reading the Qurʾān in a mosque during iʿtikāf
worship.caption: Reading the Qurʾān during iʿtikāf.
worship.alt_ms: Seorang jemaah membaca al-Quran di masjid ketika iktikaf

dua.title: File:Supplication for Forgiveness and Personal Needs During Ramadan.jpg
dua.alt: A worshipper with hands raised in supplication during Ramadan
dua.caption: Hands raised in duʿāʾ during Ramadan.
dua.alt_ms: Seorang jemaah menadah tangan berdoa pada bulan Ramadan
dua.caption_ms: Tangan ditadah berdoa pada bulan Ramadan.

dua.title: File:Lanterns Illuminated.jpg
dua.alt: Lit lanterns glowing in the dark
dua.caption: Lanterns lit for the nights of Ramadan.

planner.title: File:Mosque with mahya at night Istanbul 2026.jpg
planner.alt: A mosque in Istanbul at night with a mahya, a string of lights hung between its minarets for Ramadan
planner.caption: A mahya, the Ramadan message in lights strung between minarets, Istanbul.
planner.alt_ms: Sebuah masjid di Istanbul pada waktu malam dengan mahya, rangkaian lampu yang digantung di antara menaranya untuk Ramadan
planner.caption_ms: Mahya, pesanan Ramadan dalam bentuk lampu yang direntang di antara menara, Istanbul.

planner.title: File:Ramadan fanoos.JPG
planner.alt: A decorated Ramadan lantern (fanoos) glowing at night
planner.caption: A Ramadan lantern, or fanoos.
planner.alt_ms: Tanglung Ramadan berhias (fanus) yang menyala pada waktu malam

faq.title: File:Fanous Ramadan.jpg
faq.alt: Coloured Ramadan lanterns hanging in a row
faq.caption: Ramadan lanterns (fawānīs).
faq.alt_ms: Tanglung-tanglung Ramadan berwarna-warni tergantung dalam satu barisan

sources.caption_ms: Helaian al-Quran dalam tulisan Kufi, Cleveland Museum of Art.

sources.caption_ms: Helaian al-Quran dari abad ke-8 hingga ke-9.
